name: GPU-accelerated Marching Cubes with Distance Extraction
definition: A technique to extract an STL mesh from a signed distance function (SDF) by first extracting vertex distances from a GLSL shader to reduce GPU/CPU round trips, then processing the data on the CPU.
summary: GPU-accelerated Marching Cubes with Distance Extraction extracts surface meshes from signed distance functions by offloading scalar field evaluation to the GPU while performing topological mesh generation on the CPU.
